title: Design Loop Deep Dive
eyebrow: Second pass over design_loop.py · nothing changed yet

short.lead: I read the whole design loop and fed its real functions the messages and edits a hook receives, in throwaway repos. The full audit had found four design-loop problems; this pass found twelve more. Four of them let the code lock open without aj. First, a pull request comment or a scheduled reminder can approve a stage. Second, a question that quotes an approval counts as one. Third, the old stage file in .git/ can still be written to. Fourth, .claude/settings.json can switch the loop off. Five more make approvals do the wrong thing. The biggest hole is still open: since issue #309, a shell command that writes a source file is no longer blocked.
short.hint: Tap a card to see the evidence behind it.
items: All 2281 lines of design_loop.py, plus the parts of core.py it calls

Each finding was proved by a probe script that made a throwaway git repo and called _loop_scope_note for aj's messages and _loop_gate for edits. GitHub labels came from the same stand-in file verify.py uses. Two low findings are by reading only. The earlier full audit's findings 2, 7, 9 and 19 are not repeated here.
Four ways the lock opens without aj

Finding 1: a GitHub comment event or a scheduled reminder reaches the approval check as if aj typed it; a comment saying 'Build plan approved: feat' moved Plan to Build. Finding 2: 'What would happen if I said Design approved: login page?' moved the stage, and 'Please don't skip design' set the skip. Finding 3: in a project with no stage file yet, writing .git/house-rules-loop.json is allowed and opens Build. Finding 4: .claude/settings.json, source files in .claude/worktrees/ and code under docs/ are all editable in every stage.
Five approvals that do the wrong thing

Finding 5: re-approving the design during Build, or sending 'QA failed: X. Design approved: X' in one message, leaves the feature's issues stranded, so nothing can find them. Finding 6: the feature name in an approval is never checked, so 'QA passed: typo' passes the current feature. Finding 7: 'skip design' typed in Build survives into a later stage, and the first edit by anyone, not just aj, uses it up. Finding 8: any claude.ai artifact link counts as the QA page. Finding 9: switching to an old branch brings back that branch's old stage, and when GitHub can't be read, the old recorded labels let edits through.
Shell writes are still only reported

Since #309, a shell command that writes a source file in Design or Plan is reported and let through. So today the lock stops the Write and Edit tools only, which limits how much findings 1 to 9 matter. The fix waits on the planned restructure of the design loop, and nothing here proposes one.
Choose which findings to fix (A, B or C under Choices). Approving starts the fix as a feature, with one issue per step and one verify.py test case for each finding.
Send "Design approved: design loop fixes" along with your pick (A, B or C), or tell me what to change.

changes: chg
1. Only aj's own message approves
core.py:1916-1933, used at design_loop.py:936.
The code recognises five text markers that mark a message as not from aj. Pull request events, scheduled reminders and webhooks have none of them, so they pass as aj.
Markers for those three sources are added, and one real scheduled-reminder message is saved as a verify.py test fixture.
Proved for the comment event. Unverified: whether Claude Code also sets an origin field in the message data for these turns.
chg
2. Questions and 'don't' stop counting
design_loop.py:371-383 and :887-889.
An approval phrase anywhere in the message counts, inside a question or after 'don't'.
It counts only at the start of a line, and not on a line that asks a question or says don't, do not or not yet.
Proved: both messages moved the loop.
chg
3 and 4. Close the side doors
.git/house-rules-loop.json, .claude/settings.json, .claude/worktrees/ source files and docs/*.py are all editable before Build.
The legacy stage file is refused or no longer read; settings files are locked; a worktree path is measured from the worktree; only non-code files stay open under docs/.
Proved: for each of these writes, the loop made no allow-or-refuse decision at all. Unverified: how soon a change to the settings file takes effect in running hooks.
chg
5 and 6. Approvals move the feature aj named
Re-approving the same feature leaves its issues stranded, and any name in an approval moves the current feature.

Re-approving the same name keeps its issues in place. Approval phrases in one message apply in the order written. An unknown name is refused, and the note shows both the name given and the current feature's name.
Proved: QA was then refused with the message 'the stage is Plan', and 'QA passed: typo' wrote a record that lets the feature's issues be closed.
chg
7 and 8. Skip and the QA page mean what they say
A skip typed in Build lasts into later stages and is used by whichever edit comes first. Any claude.ai artifact link passes the QA page check.
A skip is ignored in Build and cleared on every stage change. Only the link that make_page.py published counts as the QA page.
Proved by runs.
chg
9. An old branch is not a key
design_loop.py:545-569 and :1024-1031.
After running git switch to an old branch, if GitHub can't be read, the loop falls back to that branch's old recorded labels and allows the edit.
A failed GitHub read in Build refuses the edit and says why.
Proved by removing the stand-in file that supplies GitHub labels in the probe.
choices: Findings 1 to 4, each with its own verify.py test case
These are the ways the lock opens without aj.
Fixes the wrong-approval bugs too, but it is a bigger change to review.
Fold them into the full audit's fix as extra steps
One feature for everything, but the full audit's fix grows by nine findings.
My suggestion is findings 1 to 4, because they break the loop's one promise: only aj moves the stage.

wrapup.summary: Twelve design-loop findings the earlier full audit missed. Ten were proved by running probe scripts and two were found by reading the code. Four of them open the code lock without aj.
